small_domain: At N3, all ordered valid intervals from signed2 endpoints (-2,-1,0,1), with weights0 or1, for lengths0..3; exhaustive subset oracle
other_profiles: Fixed empty/error/tie/adjacency/nesting/greedy-counterexample/max-sum families plus 20 seeded arbitrary-domain frames; exhaustive subsets for K<=17
maximum_profile: Fixed families and 20 seeded arbitrary-domain frames; independent endpoint-event sweep oracle; eight designated small-prefix frames also crosschecked by subsets
independent_oracle: Coordinate event sweep over endpoint values, carrying best feasible sets, independent of RTL min-finish selection and per-ending-interval DP; exhaustive all-subset crosscheck for K<=17
reset_matrix: All 10 FSM states plus middle collection, middle selection scan, middle predecessor scan, middle work iteration, middle replay, empty/error output, held output with next source offered; immediate reset and complete fresh recovery after each probe
on_timeout: Stop; preserve TIMEOUT_NOT_RUN; never shrink, increase time or retry
